settings.heading: Garment Care
settings.paragraph:
To keep your Dusty Wattle clothing in top condition, we recommend the following washing guidelines:

Check the Care Label: Always start by reading the care label on your garment for specific washing instructions. Different fabric types have different care instructions. 

Gentle Cycle: Wash your items on a gentle cycle in cold water to prevent fading and shrinkage.

Eco Detergent: Use eco detergent that is suitable for cotton fabric to help maintain the quality of the material.

Inside Out: Turn your garments inside out before washing to protect the outer surface and prints.

Avoid Fabric Softeners: Skip fabric softeners, as they can break down the fibers over time.

Air Dry: Whenever possible, air dry your clothing by laying it flat or hanging it up. Avoid direct sunlight to prevent fading. If you must use a dryer, choose a low heat setting.

By following these care tips, you can help ensure that your Dusty Wattle pieces remain vibrant and long-lasting.

settings.heading: Accessory Care
settings.paragraph:
To keep your accessories looking their best and prolong their lifespan, follow these care tips:

Store Properly: Keep your accessories in a dry, cool place. Avoid leaving them out in direct sunlight or damp areas.

Clean Regularly: Gently clean your accessories with a soft cloth after wearing them to remove oils, dirt, and makeup.

Avoid Chemicals: Keep your accessories away from harsh chemicals, including perfumes, lotions, and cleaning products, as these can damage the finish or materials.

Take Care with Water: Remove your earrings before swimming, showering, or exercising to prevent exposure to chlorine, saltwater, or excessive sweat.

By following these care tips, you can help ensure that your Dusty Wattle accessories remain long lasting.
